capabilities: prevent duplicate tabs of the same note
focus the existing tab when a note is already open
apply deduplication to links, menus and hotkeys
extras: Requires the Obsidian setting Settings → Editor → Always focus new tabs to be enabled; pre-release versions are installed via BRAT. Author promotes a separate paid app (Actions for Obsidian) in the README.
problem: Obsidian will happily open the same note in multiple tabs, so the same file can end up open in several places across panes.
summary: Tab deduplication plugin that ensures each note occupies only one tab per window pane, focusing the existing tab instead of opening the file again.
